jobs.description:
Description

FLSA Status:
Full-time, Non-Exempt

Compensation:
$25.00-$31.00 per hour

Post Date:
September 24, 2026

Close Date:
October 08, 2026

To apply for this position:
Please submit a resume and cover letter. Your resume will not be considered if a cover letter is not included.

As a Project Coordinator (ARG) – Data Management, you will play a vital role in supporting Community HealthWorks' data systems by ensuring accurate data entry, validation, and reporting.

This position will work closely with program teams, leadership, and external partners to assist with data workflows, maintain quality control, and generate reports as they pertain to the Adult Reentry Grant (ARG). The Project Coordinator supports Salesforce NPC data processes, troubleshoots data issues, and provides technical assistance to internal users to ensure efficient system use.

Key Responsibilities

Data Entry, Quality Control & Validation

Ensure accurate and timely data entry into Salesforce NPC and other data systems.
Enter referrals into Salesforce NPC on a daily basis
Complete quality control for ARG referrals, assessments, and services to ensure accuracy in the data
Identify and resolve data inconsistencies, formatting errors, and duplicate entries.
Use Excel functions (e.g., formulas, pivot tables, conditional formatting) to clean, validate, and analyze data.
Support data validation processes, ensuring that ARG program reports are complete and accurate
Maintain data security and confidentiality, ensuring compliance with HIPAA and organizational policies.

Referral Management

Manage and maintain the Reentry email inbox
Respond to inquiries in a timely manner
Enter referrals into Salesforce NPC on a daily basis and assign the referral accordingly

Reporting & Documentation

Assist in generating routine reports, program dashboards, and data summaries for leadership and funders.
Utilize pivot tables, v-lookups, and basic formulas in Excel to assist in report generation and data organization.
Support the development of process documentation and workflow improvements to enhance efficiency.
Complete ad hoc data requests for mailing lists, program reports, and internal performance tracking.

User Support & Training

Assist internal staff with troubleshooting data entry challenges, understanding reporting functions, and following best practices for maintaining accurate and secure data.
Respond to requests for minor system fixes and escalate more complex issues to the Data Management Manager as needed.
Support staff training on database navigation, reporting tools, and data integrity standards.

Collaboration & Team Support

Support the Data Management Manager and ARG Project Manager(s) by executing data workflows, maintaining records, and assisting with report generation.
Work collaboratively with program teams and leadership to ensure data is aligned with program goals and reporting requirements.
Participate in team meetings and cross-functional projects to improve data-driven processes.

Other Duties As Assigned

Support special projects related to data management, compliance, and operational reporting.

Requirements

Education & Experience:

Associate’s degree (A.A.) or equivalent from a two-year college or technical school in Public Health, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or a related field; OR
2+ years of experience in data entry, reporting, or technical support in a nonprofit, healthcare, or social services setting.

Technical Skills

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (ability to use formulas, pivot tables, v-lookups, and other basic data analysis tools).
Experience working with database systems (Salesforce preferred), Microsoft Word, and SharePoint.
Strong attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and reporting.

Analytical & Organizational Skills

Ability to identify and resolve basic data issues independently.
Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple priorities.

Communication & Training

Strong verbal and written communication skills.
Ability to explain data processes and system functions to non-technical staff.

Position Type and Expected Hours of Work

This is a full-time position. Days and hours of work are Monday through Friday between the hours of 8:00 a.m. to 5 p.m. and subject to change based on the program needs.

How To Apply To Apply, Please Submit The Following

A resume detailing your relevant experience and skills.
A cover letter explaining why you’re excited to join Community HealthWorks and how your experience aligns with the role.

We look forward to hearing from you and welcoming you to our team!

jobs.description:
Description

University Health Network (UHN) is hiring a Data Analyst
to work in the growing field of Healthcare Value Based Care. This position offers a hybrid work from home option for employees who meet performance requirements. Candidate must reside in the Knoxville, Tennessee metropolitan area and be able to commute to the corporate office located in Knoxville, TN when needed. Candidate must be able to maintain HIPAA privacy requirements when working in a home office setting.

University Health Network is a clinically integrated network and manages University Health ACO, LLC (an accountable care organization). We work in partnership with the University of Tennessee Medical Center, University Physicians’ Association (UPA), area physicians, and commercial and Medicare insurance companies. We strive to deliver the healthcare triple aim: Better care for individuals, better health for populations, and lowering growth in expenditures.

Benefits Include

Remote Work Opportunity
Medical (including HDHP options), Dental, Vision, Life Insurance
FSA and HSA with employer contribution
Paid Time Off (PTO) and Sick Leave
Onsite Fitness Center
Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
401K Match with Immediate Vesting

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

The Data Analyst is a full-time position that is responsible for analyzing large sets of data from multiple sources. The Data Analyst creates and validates multiple weekly and monthly end user reports. They will also monitor process performance, satisfaction of our customers, and identify improvements in data collection that will better meet the needs of the department. Experience with SQL, Python, Power BI, and ETL processes is highly desired. This position reports to the Manager of Data Analytics.

Requirements

BS in Data Analytics, Computer Science, Information Management, Statistics, or relevant field desired.
Proven working experience as a data analyst or similar role required. Will consider education in lieu of work experience.
Proficiency in programming languages including SQL and Python.
Proficiency using data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Familiarity with ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes desired.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to collect, organize, analyze, and disseminate significant amounts of information with attention to detail and accuracy.
Excellent communication skills and the ability to work independently and as part of a team.

jobs.description:

Under the direction of the Director of Institutional Research, this position will consult with functional and academic offices to identify their data and reporting needs, then coordinate the transformation, storage, and management of the data using a variety of tools and database systems with special emphasis on delivering high-quality reports and information to stakeholders to support operations and decision-making.

Consult with functional and academic offices to identify data sources and reporting needs.
Work with subject matter experts to document metadata for data systems, elements, and reports.
Translate functional and academic data needs into technical specifications.
Assist with the design and creation of databases to store and manage information.
Assist with data cleaning, transformation, storage, and validation.
Identify data quality metrics and conduct regular data quality audits.
Assist with the creation of data extracts and dashboards to support reporting requirements.
Recommend improvements to data management policies and standards.
Build and maintain effective working relationships with other offices on campus.
Assist with the creation and maintenance of procedural documentation.
Perform other duties related to data management and institutional research as assigned.

COMPETENCIES

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

Collaboration/Teamwork, Computer Software Skills, Customer Service, Data Analysis, Decision-making, Internet Research, Interpersonal Skills, Math Skills, Multi-tasking, Written Communication, Organizational Skills, Problem-solving, Project Management, Public Speaking, Time Management, Typing/Word Processing

Individual Contributor

Work is rarely required outside of normal business hours

Sitting, walking, standing, repetitive motion, primarily computer-related tasks

Bachelor’s Degree in a related field

Two years of working with databases, creating reports, analytics, or other related experience

An equivalent combination of education and experience may be used.

SQL
Ellucian Banner
Student Information System/ERP

Must have experience with data extraction and analysis tools. Understand SQL either directly or through a visual builder tool.

jobs.description:
Role
: Data Analyst

HRforGrowth® is engaged as the talent acquisition partner to conduct this search on behalf of a client organization that is hiring for this role. HRforGrowth is not the employer for this position. HRforGrowth identifies, evaluates, and presents top-tier candidates through its global talent acquisition practice; all employment decisions — including final selection, offer terms, compensation, and conditions of employment — are made solely by the hiring organization.

Our Client is seeking an experienced Data Analyst to help enhance efficiency, product scalability, and data-driven operational decision-making. This role will perform critical data analysis and build data-driven solutions that enable engineering, product, leadership, and other internal teams to deliver transformative software solutions to healthcare providers.

The successful candidate will work with large-scale data environments, develop analytics and visualizations, build scalable data products, improve internal tooling and operational workflows, and help maintain the organization's business intelligence infrastructure. The ideal candidate combines strong technical data skills with a product-oriented mindset and the ability to communicate complex data concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Location
: San Francisco, CA; New York, NY; or Denver, CO

Job Type
: Full-Time

Work Setup
: Hybrid — 4 days per week in-office and 1 day remote

Compensation
: $135,000 – $200,000 per year

Visa Sponsorship
: Open to visa transfers, including OPT and H-1B transfers; sponsorship and relocation assistance are available.

Key Responsibilities

Perform critical data analysis across a broad range of business, product, engineering, and operational use cases.
Build analytics, dashboards, and visualizations that provide actionable insights to internal stakeholders.
Deliver data-driven insights that support business strategy and operational decision-making.
Develop internal data products and tools that improve team efficiency, self-service capabilities, and operational workflows.
Build robust and scalable data models that support high-value data products and client needs.
Work with large-scale datasets and complex data environments to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
Design and maintain data workflows, ETL processes, and process automation solutions.
Own and support the implementation and ongoing maintenance of the BI platform.
Maintain reporting and visualization platforms to ensure data remains accurate, accessible, and available.
Collaborate closely with engineering, product, leadership, and other cross-functional stakeholders.
Translate complex analytical findings into clear, actionable recommendations.
Help identify opportunities to improve data accessibility, tooling, operational efficiency, and product scalability.
Contribute to the development of scalable data solutions that support evolving business and customer requirements.
Participate in continuous improvement of data processes, systems, and analytical capabilities.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Science, Engineering, or another data-intensive field of study.
Minimum 4+ years of professional experience in data analysis, ETL, process automation, and data warehousing at scale.
Minimum 3+ years of hands-on experience working with Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift.
Advanced SQL skills with experience working in complex, large-scale data environments.
Experience performing data analysis and developing actionable insights for business and operational decision-making.
Experience building and maintaining scalable data models and data products.
Strong understanding of how different users consume and leverage data, with the ability to develop appropriate insights, tools, and solutions for their needs.
Experience working with data warehouses and large-scale data environments.
Experience with dbt, Python, and Terraform.
Strong experience within the Google Cloud Platform / BigQuery ecosystem.
Ability to build analytics, reporting, and visualization solutions for a variety of stakeholders.
Strong product-building mindset with the ability to develop solutions beyond basic reporting.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex data concepts clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to work effectively in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment and independently tackle complex problems with significant business impact.

Preferred Technical Experience

Experience or exposure with the broader data and technology ecosystem, including:

Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
BigQuery
Snowflake
Redshift
dbt
Python
Terraform
Metabase
ETL and data automation
Business intelligence and data visualization platforms

Preferred Background

Experience working in a high-growth startup environment, particularly in a data analytics or data science capacity.
Experience building data products and internal tools rather than focusing exclusively on reporting.
Experience supporting engineering, product, and operational teams with scalable data solutions.
Experience working directly with clients or customer-facing teams and translating their data needs into practical solutions.

Role Expectations

The Ideal Candidate Should Demonstrate

Strong technical depth in SQL and large-scale data environments.
A product-oriented approach to data analytics.
The ability to turn ambiguous business problems into scalable data solutions.
Strong ownership and accountability for data products and analytical initiatives.
Clear and concise communication.
Comfort working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
The ability to explain complicated concepts in simple and actionable terms.
A willingness to work in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Backgrounds That May Not Align With This Role

Role

The hiring organization is specifically seeking candidates with strong technical and product-building capabilities. The following backgrounds may not align as closely with the role:

Candidates whose experience is limited primarily to reporting without meaningful data-product or solution-building experience.
Candidates whose professional background consists exclusively of slow-moving or large enterprise environments without demonstrated experience operating in a high-growth environment.
Contractor or consultant-only backgrounds without comparable full-time ownership of data products or analytics initiatives.
Candidates whose experience does not demonstrate advanced SQL capabilities in complex, large-scale data environments.
Candidates without meaningful hands-on experience with Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift.
Healthcare experience alone is not a substitute for the required technical data experience.
A Master's degree is not required; candidates with advanced degrees should also demonstrate the required professional data experience and a clear alignment with the role

jobs.title: Senior Healthcare Data Analyst, Health Plan Strategy
jobs.description:
Company Description

You may know us as FIJI Water, POM Wonderful, JUSTIN Vineyards & Winery, Teleflora, and Wonderful Halos, but we’re all Wonderful. We have an exciting opportunity for a Senior Healthcare Data Analyst, Health Plan Strategy
to help shape the strategy and performance of The Wonderful Company’s U.S. self-funded health plans.

This is a hands-on healthcare analytics role for someone who can turn complex medical, pharmacy, clinical, financial, and eligibility data into meaningful insights and recommendations. You’ll analyze what’s driving healthcare costs and utilization, forecast future trends, evaluate programs and vendor performance, and identify opportunities to improve employee health outcomes while managing total healthcare spend.

Working closely with Benefits leadership and our Wonderful Wellness Centers, you’ll help connect data to decisions across health plan design, clinical programs, vendor strategy, and long-term healthcare planning. This is a senior individual-contributor role with significant visibility and the opportunity to influence strategy through analytics, project leadership, and cross-functional partnership.

The position reports to the Sr. Director, Health Plan & Benefits and works closely with the Director, Global Benefits.

This position is based at our West Los Angeles, CA office. We work a hybrid schedule with an in-office requirement Monday through Wednesday and the option to work remotely Thursday and Friday.

Job Description

Analyze medical, pharmacy, clinical, financial, and eligibility data using SQL and other analytical tools to identify cost drivers, utilization patterns, and emerging trends.
Develop forecasting models, cost projections, trend analyses, and scenarios to support budgeting and long-term health plan strategy.
Translate complex healthcare data into actionable recommendations related to plan design, cost management, clinical programs, and employee health outcomes.
Establish financial, clinical, and utilization metrics and reporting frameworks to monitor health plan performance.
Evaluate health plan, vendor, and clinical program performance, including financial impact, health outcomes, utilization, member experience, and ROI.
Conduct benchmarking analyses to identify opportunities to improve plan performance and benefit design.
Identify opportunities to leverage The Wonderful Company’s on-site health centers and clinical resources to improve health outcomes and reduce avoidable healthcare costs.
Partner with Benefits leadership and the Chief Medical Officer to evaluate significant clinical, utilization, and cost trends.
Develop clear, executive-ready presentations that turn complex analysis into key insights and recommendations.
Lead cross-functional analytical projects by aligning stakeholders, managing timelines, and driving work through completion.

Qualifications

4+ years of healthcare data analytics experience working with medical and/or pharmacy claims data.
Hands-on experience analyzing large healthcare datasets and identifying cost, utilization, and performance trends.
Proficiency with SQL and experience with reporting or visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or SSRS.
Experience with financial modeling, forecasting, trend analysis, or healthcare cost analysis.
Strong understanding of healthcare cost and utilization drivers with the ability to translate analysis into business recommendations.
Experience communicating complex findings to non-technical stakeholders and senior leaders.
Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience analyzing healthcare claims or plan performance for self-funded employer populations.
Experience within a self-funded employer, health plan/payer, TPA, PBM, benefits consulting firm, or healthcare analytics organization.
Knowledge of employer-sponsored health benefits, health plan design, healthcare benchmarking, and/or clinical program evaluation.
Master’s degree in a related field.

Salary: $110,000-$125,000 and may include a discretionary bonus. Final compensation will be dependent upon skills & experience.

Additional Information

Thriving Wellness Community: Access to top-notch medical coverage comprehensive vision and dental plans, and a 401k with match eligibility to secure your financial future and including:
24/7 online physician consultations
virtual mental health resources
life coaching
engaging employee community groups
cash rewards for healthy habits and fitness reimbursements
library of on-demand fitness videos

Career Advancement Opportunities: Unlock your potential with clear paths for career progression and internal mobility across our diverse family of brands and business units.
Focused Learning and Development: Grow as a leader with our dedicated Learning and Organizational Development department, offering extensive resources like People Manager and leadership training, webinars, and eLearning courses.
Empowering Mentorship Program: Connect with colleagues through our company-wide mentorship program to share goals, overcome challenges, and drive your career forward.
Continuous Improvement Training: Participate in training that empowers all employees to learn and implement concepts that drive significant, positive change in the workplace.
Building a Healthy Society: To date, our co-Founders Lynda and Stewart Resnick, through their foundations and The Wonderful Company, have invested more than $2.5 billion in education, health and wellness, community development, and sustainability initiatives across California’s Central Valley, Fiji, and the world. In 2025, Wonderful ranked as #1 in PEOPLE’s “100 Companies That Care” list and was named one of Fortune magazine’s 100 Best Companies to Work For. To learn more about our corporate social responsibility efforts, visit csr.wonderful.com.
Giving Back to the Community: Make a difference with Wonderful Giving, allowing you to allocate company-provided funds to up to three charities of your choice, and join Wonderful Neighbor to contribute to group service projects within our local communities.

Headquartered in Los Angeles, The Wonderful Company is a privately held $6 billion company dedicated to harvesting health around the world through its iconic consumer brands. The company’s 10,000 employees worldwide are committed to bringing consumers everywhere the freshest, most wholesome pistachios, citrus and pomegranates; bottling the finest water and wines; and creating colorful bouquets that are sure to touch the heart. This commitment is reflected in the company’s market share: Wonderful Pistachios® is America’s No. 1 tree nut and America’s fastest-growing snack; Wonderful® Halos® is the No. 1 mandarin orange in America; POM Wonderful® is the No. 1 100% pomegranate brand in America; FIJI® Water is America’s No. 1 premium imported bottled water brand; JUSTIN® Wine has the No. 1 Cabernet Sauvignon in California; and Teleflora® is the world’s leading floral delivery service.

The Wonderful Company’s connection to consumers has health at its heart and giving back at its core. The company has a long-standing commitment to corporate social responsibility, including more than $1 billion invested in environmental sustainability; $65 million in charitable giving, education initiatives, and innovative health and wellness programs each year; and $143 million toward the construction of two charter school campuses in California’s Central Valley. To view the current Corporate Social Responsibility report, visit www.wonderful.com/csr.

To learn more about The Wonderful Company, its products and its core values, visit www.wonderful.com, or follow us on Facebook, Twitter and Instagram.

The Wonderful Company is an Equality Opportunity Employer that provides opportunities for advancement. We are committed to creating a diverse workforce that embodies a deep culture of acceptance, equity, and inclusion. You may know us as FIJI Water, POM Wonderful, JUSTIN Vineyards & Winery, Teleflora, and Wonderful Halos, but we’re all Wonderful. We have an exciting opportunity for a Senior Healthcare Data Analyst, Health Plan Strategy
to help shape the strategy and performance of The Wonderful Company’s U.S. self-funded health plans.

This is a hands-on healthcare analytics role for someone who can turn complex medical, pharmacy, clinical, financial, and eligibility data into meaningful insights and recommendations. You’ll analyze what’s driving healthcare costs and utilization, forecast future trends, evaluate programs and vendor performance, and identify opportunities to improve employee health outcomes while managing total healthcare spend.

Working closely with Benefits leadership and our Wonderful Wellness Centers, you’ll help connect data to decisions across health plan design, clinical programs, vendor strategy, and long-term healthcare planning. This is a senior individual-contributor role with significant visibility and the opportunity to influence strategy through analytics, project leadership, and cross-functional partnership.

The position reports to the Sr. Director, Health Plan & Benefits and works closely with the Director, Global Benefits.

This position is based at our West Los Angeles, CA office. We work a hybrid schedule with an in-office requirement Monday through Wednesday and the option to work remotely Thursday and Friday.

Job Description

Analyze medical, pharmacy, clinical, financial, and eligibility data using SQL and other analytical tools to identify cost drivers, utilization patterns, and emerging trends.
Develop forecasting models, cost projections, trend analyses, and scenarios to support budgeting and long-term health plan strategy.
Translate complex healthcare data into actionable recommendations related to plan design, cost management, clinical programs, and employee health outcomes.
Establish financial, clinical, and utilization metrics and reporting frameworks to monitor health plan performance.
Evaluate health plan, vendor, and clinical program performance, including financial impact, health outcomes, utilization, member experience, and ROI.
Conduct benchmarking analyses to identify opportunities to improve plan performance and benefit design.
Identify opportunities to leverage The Wonderful Company’s on-site health centers and clinical resources to improve health outcomes and reduce avoidable healthcare costs.
Partner with Benefits leadership and the Chief Medical Officer to evaluate significant clinical, utilization, and cost trends.
Develop clear, executive-ready presentations that turn complex analysis into key insights and recommendations.
Lead cross-functional analytical projects by aligning stakeholders, managing timelines, and driving work through completion.

Qualifications

4+ years of healthcare data analytics experience working with medical and/or pharmacy claims data.
Hands-on experience analyzing large healthcare datasets and identifying cost, utilization, and performance trends.
Proficiency with SQL and experience with reporting or visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or SSRS.
Experience with financial modeling, forecasting, trend analysis, or healthcare cost analysis.
Strong understanding of healthcare cost and utilization drivers with the ability to translate analysis into business recommendations.
Experience communicating complex findings to non-technical stakeholders and senior leaders.
Bachelor’s degree in a related field.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience analyzing healthcare claims or plan performance for self-funded employer populations.
Experience within a self-funded employer, health plan/payer, TPA, PBM, benefits consulting firm, or healthcare analytics organization.
Knowledge of employer-sponsored health benefits, health plan design, healthcare benchmarking, and/or clinical program evaluation.
Master’s degree in a related field.

virtual mental health resources
life coaching
engaging employee community groups
cash rewards for healthy habits and fitness reimbursements
library of on-demand fitness videos

Empowering Mentorship Program: Connect with colleagues through our company-wide mentorship program to share goals, overcome challenges, and drive your career forward.
Continuous Improvement Training: Participate in training that empowers all employees to learn and implement concepts that drive significant, positive change in the workplace.
Building a Healthy Society: To date, our co-Founders Lynda and Stewart Resnick, through their foundations and The Wonderful Company, have invested more than $2.5 billion in education, health and wellness, community development, and sustainability initiatives across California’s Central Valley, Fiji, and the world. In 2025, Wonderful ranked as #1 in PEOPLE’s “100 Companies That Care” list and was named one of Fortune magazine’s 100 Best Companies to Work For.
